items.question: Is prior experience required?
items.answer: No, most courses are designed for complete beginners.

items.question: How does the learning process work?
items.answer: Classes take place three times a week offline. Online learning is also available.

items.question: Is installment payment available?
items.answer: Yes, installments are available for up to six months.

items.question: Do you help with job placement?
items.answer: Yes. Our career center helps with resumes, portfolios, and job hunting.

internship.lead: If you already have some experience and want to work on real projects, we offer a 3-month internship.
internship.description: The program helps people with IT education who lack practical experience gain hands-on skills in a real work environment, build a portfolio and resume, and prepare for employment.
whoCanJoinItems: People with basic knowledge who want to start working in IT.
activitiesItems: Work on real IT projects and complete practical tasks.
Gain experience working in a team.
Build a personal portfolio and prepare a professional CV.
Get advice from mentors and support with job placement.
perksItems: The internship is free for students who studied at Ihsan IT Academy.
Top participants may be considered for internships at IT companies in Kazakhstan.
High-performing interns may be offered a position at the academy itself.
Support is provided with job readiness, resumes, and portfolios.
internship.notice: Completing the internship does not guarantee employment. The academy supports participants in preparing and finding opportunities.
